elements.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to each Party.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 begins, “Each Party's aggregate liability shall not exceed,” making the cap mutual.

elements.element: The fee-based limb of the cap includes fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 expressly uses “fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim.”

elements.element: The cap includes a USD 1,000,000 floor.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 expressly includes “USD 1,000,000” as the alternative cap amount.

elements.element: The applicable cap is the greater of the 12-month fee amount and USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 states that the cap is “the greater of” the 12-month fee amount or USD 1,000,000.

elements.element: Indirect damages are excluded mutually.
elements.evidence: Section 21.2 provides that “neither Party is liable for indirect” damages, subject to the Excluded Claims carve-out and legal enforceability.

elements.element: Consequential damages are excluded mutually.
elements.evidence: Section 21.2 provides that “neither Party is liable for” consequential damages, subject to the Excluded Claims carve-out and legal enforceability.

elements.element: Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 includes a Party's breach of confidentiality obligations in Excluded Claims, and Section 21.1 excepts Excluded Claims from the cap.

elements.element: Breach of data-protection obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 includes breach of data-protection obligations in Excluded Claims, which Section 21.1 excepts from the cap.

elements.element: Breach of security obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 includes breach of security obligations in Excluded Claims, which Section 21.1 excepts from the cap.

elements.element: Indemnification obligations are uncapped.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 includes indemnification obligations in Excluded Claims, which Section 21.1 excepts from the cap.

elements.element: Liability for gross negligence is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 includes gross negligence in Excluded Claims, which Section 21.1 excepts from the cap.

elements.element: Liability for wilful misconduct is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 includes wilful misconduct in Excluded Claims, which Section 21.1 excepts from the cap.

elements.element: Liability for fraud is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 includes fraud in Excluded Claims, which Section 21.1 excepts from the cap.

elements.element: Liability for infringement of the other Party's intellectual property is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 includes infringement or misappropriation of the other Party's intellectual property in Excluded Claims, which Section 21.1 excepts from the cap.

elements.element: Customer's payment obligations are not damages for purposes of the liability cap.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 states that “Customer's obligation to pay all amounts due is not damages and is not limited by this Section.”

elements.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to each Party.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 applies the cap to “Each Party.”

elements.element: The mutual liability cap equals 12 months' fees.
elements.evidence: The cap is instead the greater of 12 months' paid-or-payable fees and USD 1,000,000. Where 12 months' fees are below USD 1,000,000, the operative cap is not equal to 12 months' fees.

elements.element: Indemnification obligations are uncapped.
elements.evidence: Indemnification obligations are Excluded Claims under Section 21.3 and are excepted from the cap by Section 21.1.

elements.element: Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Confidentiality breaches are Excluded Claims under Section 21.3 and are excepted from the cap by Section 21.1.

elements.element: Liability for gross negligence is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Gross negligence is an Excluded Claim under Section 21.3 and is excepted from the cap by Section 21.1.

elements.element: Liability for wilful misconduct is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Wilful misconduct is an Excluded Claim under Section 21.3 and is excepted from the cap by Section 21.1.

result.reason: The operative language fully implements the preferred position: a mutual greater-of cap, mutual indirect and consequential damages exclusion, all required uncapped carve-outs, and an uncapped treatment of Customer payment obligations. It does not literally satisfy the fallback's distinct cap amount because the USD 1,000,000 floor can make the cap greater than 12 months' fees. The changes are confined to the requested cap and payment-obligation provisions and leave unrelated terms intact. Drafting is clear overall, though “greater of ... or” would conventionally be drafted as “greater of ... and,” and lower-case “fees” may fail to use the defined term “Fees.”
